body: Controlling the output of Large Language Models (LLMs) is a central challenge for their reliable deployment, yet a clear understanding of the involved trade-offs remains elusive. Current approaches to conditioning are often evaluated with a narrow focus on their effectiveness at injecting or removing a target concept, neglecting generation quality. We systematically investigate a range of conditioning methods in both injection and removal scenarios. We find that efficient steering methods frequently achieve conditioning at a steep cost to fluency. Furthermore, we identify a critical yet…
summaryZh: 本文系统性地研究了大型语言模型（LLM）在条件控制（Conditioning）中的有效性与生成流畅度之间的权衡。研究发现，高效的引导方法往往以牺牲生成质量为代价。该研究为模型部署提供了重要的性能评估视角，强调在注入或移除特定概念时，必须平衡控制效果与语言流畅度。
